subject: Offer approval request — Anna Ross (Senior Software Engineer, L4) — pay mix & equity
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft offer for Anna Ross (L4) — request for pay/equity sign-off

Hi Marissa & Karthik,

Wrapping up the loop on Anna Ross (referred via BrightPath). Karthik and I agreed she’s a strong fit for L4 SWE (backend/core infra). Before I send the candidate the formal offer I need HR and manager sign-off on the pay mix and equity allocation. Draft attached.

Summary (proposed):
- Title: Senior Software Engineer (L4)
- Base: $170,000 (annual)
- Target bonus: 10% (annual, cash; eligible after first cycle)
- Equity: 0.60% RSU total, 4-year vest (25% 1yr cliff)
- Start date: target 2026-07-06
- Signing bonus: $10,000 (one-time) conditional on 30-day join

Notes/ask:
- This candidate is coming from a well-regarded mid-stage fintech with strong backend experience and lead-up potential; Karthik flagged retention risk if equity feels light.
- Karthik: can you confirm budget/headcount and whether we want to flex base vs equity here?
- Marissa: please confirm comp-band alignment and any approvals needed for the signing bonus.

Attachments: draft-offer-ROSS-L4-20260528.pdf, comp-band-L4-reference-202605.pdf

Thanks — I’m hoping to send to candidate by EOD if we can finalize.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Talent Partner (Recruiting) | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft offer for Anna Ross (L4) — request for pay/equity sign-off

Thanks Hannah — reviewed the draft and comp-band reference. Quick notes: 

- Band alignment: L4 target cash comp (base + target bonus) market 2026 median sits ~ $175–185k in Bay Area for strong backend hires. Base $170k is slightly below median.
- Equity: 0.60% is within band but on the conservative side for someone with immediate impact/retention risk. Band allows up to 0.85% RSU for high-priority backfills.
- Signing bonus: $10k is OK; can approve locally if this is for counter/retention.

Recommendations:
1) Increase base to $175,000 and keep target bonus at 10%. This keeps total cash competitive without immediate band escalation.
2) Increase equity to 0.80% RSU to address retention concerns (still within L4+ band for strong candidates).
3) Approve $10,000 signing bonus.

If you prefer to keep base at $170k, we should add a stronger RSU grant or make the bonus 12% — but I'd prefer the cash bump to avoid later counter issues.

If Karthik signs off on the $175k / 0.80% RSU, I’ll mark this as approved in the HR system and generate the final offer packet.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Comp & Total Rewards Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft offer for Anna Ross (L4) — request for pay/equity sign-off

On Thu, May 28, 2026 at 10:02 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Hannah — reviewed the draft and comp-band reference. Quick notes: ...

Hannah / Marissa — thanks for the fast turnaround. I’ve reviewed and I support Marissa’s recommendation:

- Approve base $175,000. Budget covers it under headcount 2026-Q3 L4 hires.
- Approve equity 0.80% RSU (4-year).
- Approve $10,000 signing bonus.

One additional ask: add a 6-month performance touchpoint (short note in offer) to align on goals and retention. Also confirm candidate’s allowable remote location — Anna prefers East Coast (NY) but is open to hybrid in future. That does not change comp for this role.

Please push final offer to candidate; copy me on the external send.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Engineering Manager, Platform | Redwood Inference

- Title: Senior Software Engineer (L4)
- Base salary: $175,000 per year
- Target bonus: 10% of base, annual (subject to plan terms)

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached PDF and sign the DocuSign link below within 5 business days if you want to accept the offer.
2) If you have compensation questions, loop in BrightPath or reply here — we’re happy to clarify.
